page.content:
Vinegared rice cuisine — regional styles, craft lineages, and global adaptation.

How Sushi connects

  • Topic: Edomae sushi — Edomae sushi is the Tokyo nigiri tradition within sushi.
  • Item: Sushi rice — Seasoned sushi rice is what makes a piece sushi.
  • Item: Maki — Maki is the rolled form of sushi.
  • Item: Narezushi — Fermented narezushi preceded vinegar-seasoned Edo sushi as the older form.
  • Location: Kaiten-zushi — Conveyor-belt service is a casual form of sushi, not a different cuisine.
  • Item: Sashimi — Sashimi uses the same fish craft but is not sushi without rice.

What is Sushi?

Sushi is seasoned rice plus seafood or vegetables, not raw fish alone. Edo-mae nigiri, Osaka pressed forms, conveyor-belt shops, and California rolls are chapters of the same rice-and-vinegar craft.

Key threads lead to Edomae sushi, Sushi rice, Maki, Narezushi, Kaiten-zushi and Sashimi.
